subject: AccessGuard isTourist fallback bypasses stale-visa self-heal
description: Nancy follow-up (pre-existing, not a regression) from the tourist-visa fix review. AccessGuard.js:413 isTourist() falls back to reading raw localStorage.hexworth_tourist_active when TouristVisa.js (async script inject, AccessGuard.js:1010-1012) has not executed yet. That fallback never checks hexworth_house, so in the load race a sorted user with a stale flag can get isTourist()===true on requireAll(['house',...]) pages (AccessGuard.js:851 calls isTourist() before isSorted()), showing a wrong tourist banner and skipping the self-heal. Fix: make the fallback also treat hexworth_house presence as not-tourist (mirror TouristVisa.isActive()), or delay tourist UI until TouristVisa is loaded.
